title: Warm chickpeas with lemon tahini
summary: Warm chickpeas with lemon tahini is a middle eastern dinner built around canned chickpeas in water and tahini, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Have everything for Warm chickpeas with lemon tahini chopped before the pan goes on. Pat canned chickpeas in water dry and season it.
steps.tip: A short cook only works if the chopping is finished first.

steps.instruction: Heat the oil in a wide pan and cook canned chickpeas in water until just done. Lift it out.
In the same pan, cook tahini and lemon juice until hot and lightly browned. Return canned chickpeas in water and toss with the lemon, lime or sauce.
Taste Warm chickpeas with lemon tahini, add salt if it needs it, and serve straight away.
steps.tip: Taste Warm chickpeas with lemon tahini before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.
